snippet.title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
World of Tanks: HEAT is a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter with powerful hero abilities and explosive team combat. Pilot customizable tanks and unleash Agent skills in online battles, where tactical warfare meets FPS-style intensity. Take control. Rewrite the rules. 

WISHLIST NOW for Steam, Steam Deck, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S: https://wotheat.com

Join the official Discord: https://discord.com/invite/p9BrPZXV5G

Subscribe to this channel to stay up-to-date on all things HEAT!

#worldoftanks #worldoftanksheat #wotheat #wargaming
